clues: This town is a great town in the north of its land, the most peopled town of its state. Near five million folk fill it and its ring towns.
The wet wind comes here near the end of June, each year on near the same days. It leaves as fall starts, some nine weeks on.
A Rajput king set this town up in old times. It grew to one of the great trade and war posts of the British rule.
An old river stair of the 1600s still stands in this town. A famed old shrine and a war dead yard draw guests too.
This town is the head seat of its whole wide zone. Its rule, its watch, and its law arms all keep their homes here.
